description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSubordinateAPI class, which is part of an HR management system's API layer managing subordinate relationships of employees. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting subordinate relationships, along with validation rules and detailed API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPI
classes.description: API controller class handling employee subordinate relationships, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting subordinate records, with integrated validation and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles retrieving a list of subordinates for a specific employee, applying sorting and pagination, and returning a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new subordinate relationship for an employee based on input parameters.

methods.name: setSubordinateParams
methods.description: Populates a ReportTo entity with parameters from the request payload.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, including employee number access control and sorting parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes subordinate relationships specified by IDs for a particular employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method, including employee number and subordinate IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subordinate relationship by subordinate id and employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Ensures the specified employee and subordinate IDs are accessible.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing subordinate relationship with new reporting method information.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating subordinate relationships.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule ensuring the employee number is within accessible ones.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Validation rule for the reporting method ID being a positive integer.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdsRule
methods.description: Validation rule to confirm subordinate IDs are provided as an array.
